description_nl: Every sentence the share, revoke, relabel and bill routes can answer with, and the two words that say whether a key on the usage list is your own or borrowed. bad_markup / bad_cap: a number outside what the chips allow. over_limit_*: why a borrowed key stopped working - one sentence per window. limits_saved, no_limits, markup_none, markup_some, cap_line: how a share's terms read on screen. unknown_session: a run booked before sign-in sessions were tracked. credit_low / cap_low: the warning when a share is down to its last slice (keyshare.limits warn_at_pct - 80 means 'warn when a fifth is left'). credit_added: a top-up on credit somebody already bought.
